title: Watching parades from Maison Blanche
summary: Mitchell worked at Maison Blanche and watched parades from the 13th floor.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I was working, I was working at, uh, Maison Blanche. Why does it go up on the 13th floor? That's where I had broadcasters and everything. WSB. Yeah. And you can come up there and you'll look right down at the window and look down. That's better than down there because you couldn't turn around down there. You had so much people.
Right, you couldn't see anything. You couldn't see people pulling in front.
Up there you could see right down on the thing. And you didn't have no trouble at all. But down, if you're short, you can't see, you got a fella tall in front of you.
Right, right. And you get pushed around. Yeah, pushed.
